title: Too small to make it worth it.
text:
Too small to make it worth it.. I know this is supposed to be a travel version, but I can't imagine taking this thing with you on the go when most hotels have irons for you to use. If anything, it's very inconvenient becasue the reservoir holds enough for steaming just one garmetn.
It does an okay job of steaming. If you follow the instructrions you will get a shirt or pair of pants steamed almost completely with one reservori full. But just barely.
